## Workflow

## Conventions
- Keep helper functions in src/ private (no export) unless a test file imports them; minimize exported surface [note 6]
- Prefer bun:test over vitest; run tests with `bun test` [note 5]

## Known pitfalls
- When using Array.prototype.find() on user-provided arrays in production, always guard against nullish elements. Data from external sources (DB, API) may contain null/undefined entries due to race conditions or data corruption. Use `u && u.property` instead of just `u.property` in the predicate [note 2]
- Bun occasionally serves stale transpiled TS after switching branches; remove node_modules/.cache to fix [note 1]
- `bun publish` fails with ENEEDAUTH if local .npmrc lacks a token; fix auth before retrying [note 2]

## Task playbooks
- CI: add typecheck job for src/ on every push — currently no TypeScript checking in this project [note 4]
